## About Me 👨‍💻

💡 I'm a Software Engineer who loves building things that are clean, reliable, and genuinely useful to the people who use them.
<br>
🌐 I don't like to limit myself to one layer of the stack. Every part of software engineering excites me.
<br>
🎯 I care about performance, developer experience, and writing code that my future self won't hate.
<br>
🧠 I believe the best engineers understand the layers around the one they work on.
<br>
✍️ I share what I learn on my [Blog](https://tech-blog-self.vercel.app/en-US), because explaining something is the best way to truly understand it.
<br>
🔍 I always want to know how things work under the hood, and why they break at 3 a.m.
<br>
🧱 In my free time, I build Lego sets. Snapping bricks together isn't that different from composing a system.
<br>
💬 Feel free to reach out for discussions on anything software, whether it's UI, APIs, pipelines, or infrastructure!
<br>
📫 You can email me at [asdll6618@gmail.com](mailto:asdll6618@gmail.com). I'll try to respond as soon as possible!
